focusKeyword.title: Focus Keyword
focusKeyword.description: Primary keyword for this article. Used for the keywords metadata field.

metaTitle.title: Meta Title
metaTitle.description: Optional SEO title. Leave blank to use the article title.

metaDescription.description: Optional search snippet description. Leave blank to use the article description.

canonicalUrl.title: Canonical URL

noIndex.title: No Index
noIndex.description: Prevent search engines from indexing this article.
